resources.title: 0067 Art & Design Stage 2 Scheme of Work (Cambridge)

curriculum.title: Cambridge Primary Art & Design
curriculum.note: Objectives, the three units and the vocabulary and materials for each are taken from the Cambridge Primary Art & Design (0067) Stage 2 Scheme of Work in this class folder. Cambridge suggests 10 hours per unit; this plan spreads the three units evenly across the year at one lesson a week.

objectives.title: Encounter, sense, experiment with and respond to a wide range of sources, including from a range of art from different times and cultures
Explore media, materials, tools, technologies and processes
Gather and record experiences and visual information
Learn to use a range of media, materials, tools, technologies and processes with increasing skill, independence and confidence
Select appropriate media, materials, tools, technologies and processes for a purpose
Celebrate artistic experiences and learning
Analyse, critique and connect own and others' work as part of the artistic process
Generate, develop, create, innovate and communicate ideas by using and connecting the artistic processes of experiencing, making and reflecting
Embrace challenges and opportunities, working with growing independence
Review and refine own work

units.title: Unit 2.1: Stories
units.vocabulary: storytelling, photography, graphic design, poster, storyboarding, composition, illustration, layout, frames, templates, fonts, close-ups, establishing shots
units.materials: newspapers and magazines to cut up, pencils and charcoal, crayons and felt-tip pens, paints and brushes, digital cameras, picture editing software, scissors and glue, visual journals

units.title: Unit 2.2: Sounds
units.vocabulary: vibrations, sound waves, frequency, amplitude, pitch, rhythm, improvisation, composition, monochrome, tints, tones, wax relief, sand painting, sound artist, costume designer, set designer
units.materials: percussion instruments, a globe or world map, card, coloured pencils and felt-tips, watercolours and paints, wax crayons, clay, shells, feathers, beads and glitter, coloured sand, cameras, visual journals

units.title: Unit 2.3: Places
units.vocabulary: urban environment, natural environment, architecture, inhabitants, facade, construction materials, sketch, landscape painting, pointillism, optical mixing, montage, frieze, clay work, inspiration, brief, clients
units.materials: a globe or world map, paper and thin card, pencils and felt-tips, dowelling and lollipop sticks, recycled materials, bubble wrap, textiles, air dry clay and clay tools, watercolour and acrylic paint, string, scissors, visual journals

Select appropriate media, materials, tools, technologies and processes for a purpose

plan.focus: Designing and making a tea bowl from clay
plan.prior: Lesson 37: How ideas spread from place to place
plan.next: Lesson 39: Our end-of-year exhibition
plan.intro: Recap the technique and remind the class of safe, tidy working.
main: Demonstrate the technique step by step.
Learners work on the piece, choosing their own media.
Circulate, encourage experiment, and suggest alternatives.
Learners store developmental work in their visual journals.
plan.plenary: Learners look at each other's work and name one thing they might try next time.
plan.look_for: Growing independence in choosing and handling media.
resources: media and tools for the technique

a globe or world map, paper and thin card, pencils and felt-tips, dowelling and lollipop sticks, recycled materials, bubble wrap, textiles, air dry clay and clay tools, watercolour and acrylic paint, string, scissors, visual journals
